_comment: The waitlist funnel - the only product-conversion signal this project has.
apps/website has emitted all six counters since PR #147 and nothing has
ever displayed them.
Things here were established against the live API, because each of them
fails by rendering an empty chart rather than by erroring, and an empty
funnel looks exactly like a funnel nobody entered:
1. widget_type is 'tracemetrics'. The alert API and the events API use
DIFFERENT dataset vocabularies for the same data - alerts want
'events_analytics_platform', queries want 'tracemetrics'. Neither
accepts the other's spelling.
2. THE AGGREGATE NAMES THE METRIC, AND THAT IS THE WHOLE BALLGAME.
The form is fn(value, <metric.name>, <type>, <unit>) - for these
counters, sum(value,waitlist.submit_failed,counter,none). A bare
count(value) with the metric put in `conditions` as
'metric.name:waitlist.submit_failed' is ACCEPTED on write and
returns nothing forever. Established 2026-09-26 by building one
widget by hand and reading back what Sentry generated: the correct
form returned 2, the count of events actually in the window.
This is why every widget here names its metric and carries no
metric.name condition, and it is also why the metric alert in
../alerts/ never fired - same dataset, same mistake.
3. looks_valid must be written 'tags[looks_valid,boolean]', WITH the type.
Both 'looks_valid' and 'tags[looks_valid]' resolve to a string-typed
attribute that does not exist and silently return null for every row -
which reads as 'the attribute is not being sent' when it is.
4. THIS FILE IS snake_case; THE API ANSWERS IN camelCase. Sentry accepts
widget_type and display_type on write and returns widgetType and
displayType on read. So reading the live dashboard back with the keys
written here returns null for both, which looks exactly like a
dashboard whose widgets have lost their types. Established 2026-09-26
while confirming the funnel survived: the widget really holds
displayType 'bar' and widgetType 'tracemetrics'. Do not 'fix' this
file to camelCase - the accepted form is what created the dashboard,
and that is the only form with evidence behind it.
'Funnel by step' is SIX SERIES rather than one grouped query, and that is
forced rather than chosen. It used to group by a metric.name column and
let the rows fill in the steps. Since a series addresses exactly one
metric by name, there is nothing left to group by - the funnel has to be
enumerated. The cost is that adding a seventh counter to
apps/website/src/lib/waitlist-telemetry.ts does NOT appear here until
someone adds it below too, which is the kind of quiet omission this
whole directory exists to prevent. WAITLIST_METRICS in that file is the
list to check against.
period is 30d to match trace metric retention. Measured the same day:
trace metrics go back ~30 days, logs ~90. Widen this and the funnel
truncates without saying so. The same funnel can be built on the 'logs'
widget_type for longer history - apps/website emits both for every step.
'limit' is required on any widget whose query has columns (max 10).
